hero.html:
Level 1 - Kid30 min

Design Patterns Overview & Selection Guide

What a design pattern really is, the full map (23 GoF patterns plus the modern ones interviews use), which ones to learn first, and a simple question - "where does the change live?" - that tells you which pattern a problem needs.

Pattern questions show up inside LLD rounds at Amazon Uber Flipkart Swiggy and most product companies hiring SDE-1/SDE-2.
